name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at the preacher bench with one upper arm against the angled pad and a dumbbell in that hand, palm up.
Start with your arm nearly straight and your armpit settled comfortably over the top edge of the pad.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm pressed firmly into the pad.
Lower the weight slowly back toward full extension without dropping it at the bottom, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your shoulder pressed down and avoid pulling your torso backward to help lift the weight.
Stop just short of a hard elbow lockout at the bottom to maintain steady tension on the biceps.
